groups.label: Event foundation: fail-loud emission and state derivation
groups.message:
feat(#443): event foundation — fail-loud emission, state query, lifecycle field merge

Remove @safe from worklog write path so DB errors propagate. Add
get_lifecycle_state() to query lifecycle state from events table.
Add update_lifecycle_fields() and write_plan() to plan_io for
canonical .plan writes.

Refs #443

groups.label: Bypass closure: route all .plan writes through plan_io
groups.message:
fix(#443): route all .plan writes through plan_io

Close 15 bypass paths across 8 files: lifecycle.py (2), scaffold.py (3),
work_end_orchestrator.py (5), plan_manager.py (2), plan_migrate.py (2),
migrate_meta.py (1), migrate_plan_repos.py (1). All .plan mutations
now go through plan_io.py as the single canonical writer.

Refs #443

groups.label: Enforcement and regeneration
groups.message:
feat(#443): bypass enforcement test and post-transition regeneration

Add static analysis test that greps all Python files for direct .plan
manipulation outside plan_io.py — prevents regression permanently.
Add update_lifecycle_fields() call after every lifecycle transition
to restore .plan state from authoritative source.

Refs #443
